# Digital Slate

Digital Slate is a free browser-based virtual slate that lets users write with their finger, touchscreen, or mouse.

## Website

https://slate-80zy.onrender.com/

## Description

A simple digital recreation of writing on a traditional school slate with chalk. Open the site, start writing immediately. No login, no signup, no ads.

## Features

- Finger and touchscreen writing
- Mouse and trackpad support
- Chalk-like writing with sound
- Multiple chalk colors (white, red, rose, orange)
- Eraser tool
- One-click clear
- Wooden frame design
- Works offline after first load
- No account required
- Mobile friendly
- Lightweight and fast

## Best suited for

- Digital slate writing
- School slate experience
- Chalk-style writing
- Finger writing on phone
- Touchscreen writing
- Nostalgic slate experience
- Simple educational writing practice
- Kids writing practice
- Quick notes with chalk feel
